project.name: Artificial Intelligence Gladiator Coliseum (AIGC)
project.domain: governed provider-neutral AI work operating system and certified universal website operator
project.primary_objective: Help a person discover, obtain, learn, perform, verify, and sustain lawful digitally performable work through one governed interface without treating capability, memory, or evidence as authority.
project.system_boundary: Repository-local Nexus core, policy, memory, evidence, connector passports, portable AI interfaces, and separately authorized provider or employer integrations; excludes unapproved external accounts, sites, employers, billing, communications, deployments, and physical work.

methodology_stack.name: Domain-Driven Design plus C4
methodology_stack.problem: Separate employment, connector, authority, evidence, memory, and occupation concepts without semantic collapse.
methodology_stack.selection_rationale: The project is a multi-boundary domain system whose failure modes often originate in ambiguous concepts and interfaces.
entry_criteria: material actors and data flows known
limitations: can become ceremonial without executable contracts
exit_criteria: interfaces have owners and failure semantics

methodology_stack.name: DevSecOps plus Site Reliability Engineering
methodology_stack.problem: Build, release, operate, observe, stop, and recover a long-lived work platform.
methodology_stack.selection_rationale: The target requires exact artifacts, durable controls, SLOs, incident response, and rollback.
limitations: local CI cannot prove production health
exit_criteria: controlled deployment and rollback are evidenced

methodology_stack.name: STRIDE plus LINDDUN threat and privacy modeling
methodology_stack.problem: Protect employment identity, messages, credentials, employer data, memory, and tool boundaries.
methodology_stack.selection_rationale: The platform combines high-value identities, private correspondence, third-party content, and external mutations.
limitations: requires updating after each connector change
exit_criteria: critical threats controlled or explicitly rejected

methodology_stack.name: Stage-Gate plus continuous occupation evaluation
methodology_stack.problem: Expand toward many jobs without inferring competence from general model capability.
methodology_stack.selection_rationale: Each occupation and task needs shadow, supervised, evaluated, accepted, and recertified states.
limitations: does not replace licensure or employer authorization
rejected_alternatives: promotion based only on model benchmark scores
exit_criteria: employer or qualified evaluator accepts scope

methodology_stack.name: Human-centred design plus WCAG 2.2 AA evaluation
methodology_stack.problem: Deliver a one-click interface that remains understandable, accessible, and truthful about blocked states.
methodology_stack.selection_rationale: Ease of use must coexist with visible boundaries and recoverable human intervention.
limitations: a simple interface cannot simplify away authorization or terms
rejected_alternatives: one-click interface that hides consequential gates
client-specific UI as the only interface
exit_criteria: critical tasks meet accessibility and usability targets

reasoning_uncertainty_register.conclusion: The reconstructed repository is locally testable and its current governed boundaries can be verified without external action.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.alternative_explanation: The local environment may mask a dependency or platform difference that appears in hosted CI.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.disconfirming_test: Run the exact tree in a clean supported hosted environment and observe a deterministic failure.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.magnitude: low for local behavior; high for remote release state
reasoning_uncertainty_register.decision_impact: supports local development but not merge, deployment, or production claims
reasoning_uncertainty_register.reducibility: high with a full trusted checkout and exact-head CI
reasoning_uncertainty_register.cost_of_reduction: one clean hosted CI run plus repository reconstruction
reasoning_uncertainty_register.value_of_information: high because it unlocks trustworthy release comparison
reasoning_uncertainty_register.treatment: continue local verification and keep remote state blocked

reasoning_uncertainty_register.conclusion: Gmail, Indeed, generic websites, and portable AI hosts are not live-certified in this reconstruction.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.alternative_explanation: External accounts or approvals may exist outside the repository but are not bound to this artifact.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.disconfirming_test: Resolve current provider-generated OAuth, partnership, deployment, and connector certification receipts for the exact AIGC revision.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.cost_of_reduction: registration, review, sandbox testing, and possibly security assessment
reasoning_uncertainty_register.value_of_information: high for one selected connector; low for broad simultaneous outreach
reasoning_uncertainty_register.treatment: certify one connector and operation at a time

reasoning_uncertainty_register.conclusion: AIGC can plausibly expand across many digital occupations only through scoped capability packs, not one universal competence claim.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.alternative_explanation: Some tasks may share enough structure for cross-occupation certification, while others may remain infeasible or regulated.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.disconfirming_test: Independent occupation evaluations show persistent failure, excessive supervision, or non-transferability across the first three packs.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.decision_impact: prevents universal-job marketing and requires staged promotion
reasoning_uncertainty_register.reducibility: medium through shadow work and qualified evaluation
reasoning_uncertainty_register.cost_of_reduction: employer time, curated test sets, and supervised trials
reasoning_uncertainty_register.value_of_information: very high because it determines product scope and economics
reasoning_uncertainty_register.treatment: build three packs and measure before expansion

reasoning_uncertainty_register.conclusion: A one-click interface is compatible with governance only when the click starts a bounded plan rather than granting wildcard authority.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.alternative_explanation: A user might prefer fewer gates even for consequential actions.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.disconfirming_test: Usability testing shows users cannot understand or complete the governed plan despite progressive disclosure and saved boundaries.
reasoning_uncertainty_register.treatment: prototype progressive disclosure and measure task completion

assumptions.statement: Existing tests and architecture documents define the intended narrow contracts for reconstructed missing modules.
assumptions.falsification: A trusted upstream source shows materially different public behavior.

assumptions.statement: External provider capabilities, terms, and scopes can change after this constitution is captured.
assumptions.falsification: Provider supplies a versioned immutable long-term contract covering the intended action.

assumptions.statement: Software-research, administrative-coordination, and data-analysis packs contain useful zero-egress tasks that can be evaluated locally.
assumptions.falsification: Task decomposition finds no representative work that avoids unavailable external systems.

assumptions.statement: A tool-first MCP facade can provide one useful core across supported ChatGPT and Gemini developer surfaces while leaving UI optional.
assumptions.falsification: Current host conformance testing shows required structured tools cannot operate across both supported surfaces.

risks.name: Capability or evidence mistaken for authority
risks.threat_or_hazard: A caller treats model output, memory, connector status, or test evidence as permission to mutate an external system.

risks.name: Credential disclosure
risks.threat_or_hazard: A raw credential enters prompts, logs, receipts, source, or artifacts.
risks.verification: redaction, serialization, and repository secret scans

risks.name: Duplicate application, message, or transaction
risks.threat_or_hazard: A timeout after dispatch triggers an automatic retry and duplicates an irreversible or costly action.

risks.name: Work performed beyond demonstrated competence or professional scope
risks.threat_or_hazard: General model fluency is mistaken for occupational qualification, licensure, or employer authorization.
risks.verification: independent capability-pack evaluation and scoped credential

risks.name: Provider contract or site behavior drift
risks.threat_or_hazard: A previously certified API, scope, terms version, or web flow changes.
risks.verification: expiry, terms-digest, contract, and live read-only health checks

decisions.question: How should the one-commit reconstruction recover missing imported security and connector modules?
decisions.sensitivity: high to hidden upstream API differences
irreversible_consequences: none; repository-local patch remains reviewable and reversible
decisions.selected_option: reconstruct only the narrow tested contracts
decisions.fallback: replace from trusted upstream source if later recovered

decisions.question: Which external connector should be advanced first?
decisions.sensitivity: high to provider registration time and permission
decisions.selected_option: advance one supported read or draft sandbox while keeping send and submission blocked
decisions.fallback: standalone local preparation and human handoff
decisions.reconsideration_trigger: provider changes product availability or grants written permission

decisions.question: How should AIGC expand toward many kinds of work?
decisions.sensitivity: high to employer acceptance and correction rate
irreversible_consequences: reputational harm if competence is overstated
decisions.selected_option: three scoped packs with supervised promotion
decisions.fallback: reduce to one pack with the strongest evaluation evidence
decisions.reconsideration_trigger: independent evaluation results or regulatory classification changes

decisions.question: How should AIGC connect to multiple AI hosts?
decisions.selected_option: one tool-first MCP facade plus standalone application and optional host UI
decisions.fallback: standalone app backed by the same governed core
decisions.reconsideration_trigger: host conformance tests fail or official platform support changes

heuristics.name: Clear validated blockers before polish
heuristics.rationale: Downstream refinement cannot make an invalid prerequisite true.
heuristics.failure_mode: A mislabeled blocker can starve valuable discovery
contraindications: parallel reversible discovery has high information value
heuristics.override_evidence: Evidence that the blocker is noncritical or that a parallel experiment has higher expected decision value

heuristics.name: Prefer the smallest reversible decisive action
heuristics.trigger: Several repairs or experiments could reduce uncertainty
heuristics.rationale: Reversibility limits blast radius while producing evidence.
heuristics.failure_mode: Local patches may preserve a flawed architecture
contraindications: incremental change would create false assurance
heuristics.override_evidence: Threat model or dependency proof requiring a structural replacement

heuristics.name: Deny external capability by default
heuristics.trigger: Identity, permission, destination, terms, or outcome evidence is incomplete
heuristics.rationale: Capability and user intent do not create third-party authorization.
heuristics.benefit: Prevents unauthorized or ambiguous external actions
heuristics.failure_mode: Excessive friction if certification evidence is not maintainable
contraindications: public zero-cost read explicitly allowed by policy
heuristics.override_evidence: Current certified connector, exact identity and destination, active one-use permit, and tested reconciliation

heuristics.name: Treat memory as context rather than authority
heuristics.trigger: A prior instruction, employer procedure, or result is retrieved
heuristics.rationale: Memories can be stale, poisoned, revoked, or belong to another tenant.
heuristics.benefit: Prevents stored context from escalating privileges
heuristics.override_evidence: No override; current authority must always be resolved independently

heuristics.name: Do not retry ambiguous mutations
heuristics.trigger: A call was dispatched and its outcome is unknown
heuristics.rationale: A retry can duplicate applications, messages, purchases, filings, or work artifacts.
contraindications: provider proves the original operation did not execute
heuristics.override_evidence: Authoritative readback proving no mutation, followed by fresh authority

heuristics.name: Certify one occupation pack at a time
heuristics.rationale: General model competence is not occupational qualification.
contraindications: tasks are demonstrably identical under the same legal and operational constraints
heuristics.override_evidence: Cross-occupation evaluation proving equivalence and qualified acceptance

cognitive_bias_controls.plausible_alternative: AIGC may not achieve acceptable occupational performance or provider adoption.
cognitive_bias_controls.disconfirming_test: Run independent first-three-pack evaluations and seek provider rejection criteria.
cognitive_bias_controls.change_evidence: Repeated evaluation failure or explicit provider denial changes scope and sequencing.
cognitive_bias_controls.sunk_cost_check: Prior investment does not justify live activation without current evidence.
cognitive_bias_controls.system_optimization_check: Optimize verified user and employer outcomes, not feature count.

cognitive_bias_controls.plausible_alternative: Human review or handoff may outperform autonomy for rare, legal, or ambiguous tasks.
cognitive_bias_controls.disconfirming_test: Compare governed autonomous, assisted, and manual workflows on accuracy, time, and harm.
cognitive_bias_controls.change_evidence: Higher correction or incident rates reduce the autonomy tier.
cognitive_bias_controls.sunk_cost_check: Automation already built may still be disabled.
cognitive_bias_controls.system_optimization_check: Minimize total risk-adjusted work cost rather than human interventions alone.

cognitive_bias_controls.plausible_alternative: OAuth verification, partner review, security assessment, and employer evaluation take materially longer than development.
cognitive_bias_controls.disconfirming_test: Collect actual lead times from the first connector and employer sandbox.
cognitive_bias_controls.change_evidence: Observed lead time and cost replace estimates.
cognitive_bias_controls.sunk_cost_check: Do not continue a connector solely because review has already consumed time.
cognitive_bias_controls.system_optimization_check: Preserve a useful local product while external reviews proceed.

cognitive_bias_controls.plausible_alternative: Application volume, test count, or automation rate can rise while job quality, trust, or safety falls.
cognitive_bias_controls.disconfirming_test: Audit paired outcome and guardrail metrics for divergence.
cognitive_bias_controls.change_evidence: Metric improvement without employer acceptance or verified task success triggers redesign.
cognitive_bias_controls.sunk_cost_check: Discard vanity metrics regardless of historical reporting.
cognitive_bias_controls.system_optimization_check: Pair throughput with quality, correction, authorization, and harm metrics.

parameters.name: Unauthorized external actions
parameters.definition: External mutations performed without current exact authority
parameters.baseline: 0 observed in current local tests; no live execution measured
parameters.distribution: discrete incident count; live distribution unknown
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: high confidence locally; external exposure unmeasured
parameters.measurement: correlate every dispatch receipt with a current exact permit
parameters.calibration_requirement: test audit correlator against forged, expired, and missing permits
parameters.operating_environment: all sandbox, staging, and production connectors
parameters.failure_response: system emergency stop, revoke connector, preserve evidence, investigate
parameters.verification_method: negative permit tests plus immutable receipt audit
parameters.decision_significance: any failure blocks production and triggers incident response

robustness.sensitivity: high to audit completeness and permit validation
robustness.degradation: certification or policy drift can weaken detection
robustness.margin: zero-tolerance boundary; robustness comes from layered prevention

anti_goodhart.failure_mode: missing telemetry can falsely report zero

parameters.name: Secret exposure
parameters.definition: Raw credentials in prompts, code, logs, receipts, artifacts, or chat
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: high for repository artifacts; external runtime unmeasured
parameters.measurement: secret scanning plus adversarial serialization and log tests
parameters.calibration_requirement: known synthetic secret corpus must be detected without retaining raw real secrets
parameters.sampling_frequency: every commit, build, receipt, and runtime log stream
parameters.operating_environment: repository, CI, runtime, connector, and evidence planes
parameters.failure_response: stop, revoke, rotate, contain, and document incident
parameters.verification_method: scanner, redactor, and no-secret schema tests
parameters.decision_significance: any confirmed exposure blocks release and requires credential response

robustness.nominal: no raw secret leaves the broker
robustness.worst_case: credential compromise and third-party account access
robustness.sensitivity: high to logging and exception paths
robustness.margin: defense in depth; no numeric exposure margin is acceptable

anti_goodhart.failure_mode: narrow pattern scanning can report zero while unknown secret formats leak

parameters.name: Automatic retries after ambiguous dispatch
parameters.definition: Mutation retries issued before authoritative reconciliation
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: high for tested adapters; unmeasured for future connectors
parameters.measurement: operation-key, dispatch, retry, and reconciliation audit
parameters.verification_method: lost-ack, timeout, replay, and duplicate-operation tests

robustness.margin: no retry margin after unknown outcome

robustness.best_case: no wildcard tools and automatic expiry
robustness.sensitivity: high to clock, terms, and version identity
robustness.margin: certification must be current; no missing coverage allowed

parameters.name: Mandatory requirement verification coverage
parameters.definition: Fraction of mandatory requirements connected to current exact-artifact evidence
parameters.baseline: local reconstruction tests pass; external requirements remain blocked
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: dependent on accurate requirement classification and current evidence
parameters.calibration_requirement: adversarially remove one trace link and require rejection
parameters.sampling_frequency: every material change and release decision
parameters.verification_method: semantic constitution validator plus exact-artifact tests
parameters.decision_significance: controls the maximum truthful completion claim

robustness.best_case: automatic invalidation after every material change
robustness.sensitivity: high to artifact identity and temporal validity
robustness.degradation: all evidence becomes stale after non-equivalent change

parameters.name: Verified occupation task success

parameters.tolerance: defined by task criticality and employer acceptance
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: high uncertainty until representative evaluation sample exists
parameters.measurement: blind or independently scored occupation evaluation
parameters.sampling_frequency: each evaluation cycle and sampled production work
parameters.failure_response: return to supervised mode and retrain or revoke capability
parameters.verification_method: independent scoring with confidence interval and error taxonomy
parameters.decision_significance: governs promotion, continued work, and recertification

robustness.sensitivity: high to task mix and evaluator quality
robustness.margin: must be derived per occupation; not yet calculable

parameters.name: Human correction rate
parameters.definition: Fraction of delivered work requiring material correction
parameters.target: derived from occupation and employer risk tolerance
parameters.tolerance: paired with task success, severity, and reporting guardrails
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: unknown until employer feedback is collected
parameters.measurement: employer feedback linked to exact work receipt
parameters.calibration_requirement: shared definition of material correction and severity
parameters.sampling_frequency: every delivered task during supervised phase, then risk-based sample
parameters.failure_response: reduce autonomy tier and analyze errors
parameters.verification_method: receipt-linked review and independent sample audit
parameters.decision_significance: governs autonomy tier and training priorities

robustness.sensitivity: high to reviewer incentives and task complexity
robustness.degradation: review quality can decline over time
robustness.margin: must be established by employer risk tolerance

parameters.name: External action blast radius
parameters.definition: Maximum accounts, destinations, resources, and mutations authorized by one permit
parameters.target: one account, one exact destination, one operation, one mutation
parameters.maximum: one unless an independently reviewed batch contract exists
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: high when semantic validation resolves authoritative resources
parameters.measurement: permit semantic validation and authoritative resource resolution
parameters.calibration_requirement: wildcard, alias, cross-account, and changed-payload adversarial cases
parameters.verification_method: server-side request binding and exact destination readback
parameters.decision_significance: limits maximum harm of a compromised or mistaken action

robustness.best_case: no credentials resolved until all bindings match
robustness.sensitivity: high to alias resolution and provider resource semantics
robustness.environmental_variation: providers model accounts and resources differently
robustness.margin: one exact action; no unresolved margin

anti_goodhart.failure_mode: one nominal action can still contain an oversized payload or recipient set

parameters.name: Cost per successful task
parameters.definition: Known provider and infrastructure cost divided by independently verified successful tasks
parameters.target: Pareto-minimize subject to quality, safety, privacy, reliability, and signed ceilings
parameters.minimum: 0 CAD where provider-free execution is valid
parameters.confidence_uncertainty: unknown until provider and infrastructure billing is reconciled
parameters.measurement: provider usage and infrastructure billing divided by verified task outcomes
parameters.calibration_requirement: billing currency, token, and task-success reconciliation
parameters.sampling_frequency: every billed action and monthly portfolio review
parameters.failure_threshold: greater than signed ceiling or unknown after dispatch
parameters.verification_method: provider receipt, cloud billing record, and task-evidence correlation
parameters.decision_significance: governs model routing, pricing, sustainability, and commercial viability

robustness.sensitivity: high to model price, retries, and task success
robustness.environmental_variation: provider prices and exchange rates change
robustness.degradation: cost rises as context and workload grow
robustness.margin: permit ceiling minus worst-case authorized request cost; must remain nonnegative

anti_goodhart.failure_mode: cutting model quality can lower cost while increasing rework

constraints.statement: Consequential external actions require current exact authority at the point of action.
constraints.scope: all external communications, submissions, spending, deployment, traffic, contracts, and work delivery
constraints.validity_period: permanent constitutional invariant unless superseded by a stricter signed policy
constraints.verification: permit and identity validation before credential access
constraints.violation_consequence: deny action and preserve a sanitized denial receipt
constraints.mitigation: resolve exact principal, destination, payload, resource, cost, expiry, and one-use permit

constraints.statement: Secrets may flow only through the governed Secret Broker route and never through prompts, code, logs, or receipts.
constraints.scope: all AIGC source, runtime, memory, evidence, connector, and operator surfaces
constraints.mitigation: use opaque secret references, workload identity, short-lived injection, and redaction

constraints.statement: Indeed application automation and messaging remain disabled without an official supported vendor route and express permission.
constraints.scope: Indeed discovery, application, messaging, and account access by AIGC
constraints.validity_period: until current written permission and provisioned service are independently verified; recheck terms before every certification

functional_properties.name: correctness
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Conformance of behavior and outcomes to exact requirements and authoritative facts.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Incorrect applications, messages, work, or receipts can harm users and employers.
functional_properties.current_state: local governed contracts pass their current tests
functional_properties.target_state: every enabled occupation and connector meets exact acceptance criteria
functional_properties.residual_risk: external provider behavior and incomplete evaluation

functional_properties.name: completeness
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Coverage of all mandatory entities, states, requirements, controls, and evidence for a claimed scope.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: A partial workflow can strand users between application, hiring, and delivery.
functional_properties.current_state: ontology is populated but live lifecycle is incomplete
functional_properties.target_state: all mandatory lifecycle gates and evidence are implemented

functional_properties.name: reliability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Probability that AIGC performs or safely declines the intended function across time and disturbances.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Employment workflows can last years and external failures cannot create duplicates.
functional_properties.current_state: deterministic local paths and reconciliation semantics exist
functional_properties.target_state: durable workflows recover without duplicate effects

functional_properties.name: security
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Protection of identity, authority, credentials, data, code, and actions against misuse.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: A work system holds valuable accounts and can affect third parties.
functional_properties.current_state: default deny, redaction, and no-secret contracts are locally tested
functional_properties.target_state: least-privilege workload identity and attack-path-tested connectors

functional_properties.name: safety
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Freedom from unacceptable harm caused by action, omission, or misleading output.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Work can affect finances, legal rights, health, infrastructure, and livelihoods.
functional_properties.current_state: high-impact work is blocked or requires human authority
functional_properties.target_state: occupation-specific hazard controls and tested emergency stops

functional_properties.name: privacy
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Purpose-limited and consent-bound handling of candidate, employer, message, and memory data.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Employment data is sensitive and crosses organizations.
functional_properties.current_state: no live mailbox or employer data is connected
functional_properties.target_state: tenant isolation, minimization, retention, deletion, and revocation are verified
functional_properties.residual_risk: provider retention and future external data flows

functional_properties.name: performance
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Timely and resource-bounded completion of admitted tasks.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Slow systems miss application, communication, and work deadlines.
functional_properties.current_state: local tests are fast but not representative of production
functional_properties.target_state: occupation-specific latency and throughput SLOs

functional_properties.name: scalability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to increase tenants, connectors, occupations, and workload without violating mandatory properties.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Breadth is a product goal but unsafe scaling amplifies errors.
functional_properties.current_state: single reconstructed repository
functional_properties.target_state: tenant-isolated ecosystem with measured capacity

functional_properties.name: usability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Effectiveness, efficiency, and confidence with which users control AIGC.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: One-click simplicity fails if users cannot understand boundaries or recover errors.
functional_properties.current_state: dashboard exposes connector states
functional_properties.target_state: tested one-click plan with progressive disclosure

functional_properties.name: accessibility
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Equivalent operability for users with diverse sensory, motor, cognitive, and device needs.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: The interface must work on mobile and assistive technologies.
functional_properties.current_state: basic Streamlit presentation only
functional_properties.target_state: WCAG 2.2 AA across standalone and optional host UI
process_requirements: keyboard, screen-reader, contrast, reflow, understandable error support
functional_properties.residual_risk: host UI differences and no human audit

functional_properties.name: interoperability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Correct exchange of structured meaning across AI hosts, connectors, workflows, and evidence systems.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Provider neutrality depends on stable tool and evidence contracts.
functional_properties.current_state: local stdio and Streamable HTTP MCP tool plane implemented and contract-tested
functional_properties.target_state: host-tested authenticated MCP plus A2A and standalone adapters
tests: MCP initialization and tool contract tests
functional_properties.residual_risk: host support, authentication, and protocol drift

functional_properties.name: maintainability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ease and safety of understanding, changing, testing, and operating the system.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Long-lived employment workflows outlast individual implementations and maintainers.
functional_properties.current_state: modular core with tests and explicit contracts
functional_properties.target_state: owned interfaces, migration rules, and low change-failure rate

functional_properties.name: resilience
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to preserve safe service or degrade safely under dependency failure and change.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Providers, sites, networks, and models will fail or change.
functional_properties.current_state: blocked and reconciliation states are explicit
functional_properties.target_state: tested degraded modes and dependency substitution

functional_properties.name: recoverability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to restore a known safe state and reconcile effects after failure.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: External mutations and multi-year workflows cannot always be rolled back.
functional_properties.current_state: reconciliation semantics exist locally
functional_properties.target_state: workflow resume, rollback, and compensation are proven

functional_properties.name: observability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to infer internal and external action state from safe, correlated signals.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Silent failure or unknown outcome prevents safe autonomy.
functional_properties.current_state: local receipts and health projections exist
functional_properties.target_state: correlated traces, metrics, events, costs, and external readback

functional_properties.name: auditability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to reconstruct who requested, authorized, executed, verified, and reconciled each material action.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Employment and external actions require accountability and dispute evidence.
functional_properties.current_state: canonical contracts and create-only intent exist
functional_properties.target_state: immutable cross-system evidence ledger

functional_properties.name: traceability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Bidirectional linkage from objective through requirements, action, test, evidence, artifact, and outcome.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Without traceability, completion claims become narrative rather than proof.
functional_properties.current_state: core ontology trace is machine-validated
functional_properties.target_state: every mandatory requirement and deployment has current exact evidence

functional_properties.name: deployability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to promote an exact verified artifact through controlled environments without semantic or authority drift.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Local correctness does not prove a deployable or correct runtime.
functional_properties.current_state: deployment scripts exist but authority and complete repository evidence are absent
functional_properties.target_state: exact digest deployment with rollback and no-traffic validation
functional_properties.residual_risk: no trusted deployment broker or permit

functional_properties.name: operability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability for authorized operators to understand, control, stop, recover, and support the running system.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Autonomy without operational control becomes brittle and unsafe.
functional_properties.current_state: local dashboard and runbooks exist
functional_properties.target_state: tested alerts, stops, support, incident, and offboarding procedures

functional_properties.name: cost efficiency
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Minimum sustainable cost for each independently verified useful outcome.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Compute and support costs must not exceed lawful revenue and user value.
functional_properties.current_state: live baseline unknown
functional_properties.target_state: Pareto-efficient routing with hard spend ceilings

functional_properties.name: sustainability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to deliver durable value without unacceptable financial, operational, environmental, or human burden.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: A years-long worker platform must remain supportable and responsible.
functional_properties.current_state: no measured production footprint or unit economics
functional_properties.target_state: measured energy, cost, support, retention, and repairability

functional_properties.name: adaptability
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Ability to change models, procedures, connectors, and task strategies while preserving mandatory invariants.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: Providers, employers, and occupations evolve.
functional_properties.current_state: versioned contracts support local change
functional_properties.target_state: evaluated migration, drift detection, and recertification

functional_properties.name: autonomy
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Capacity to plan and act within a precisely bounded, current, evidence-supported authority envelope.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: The product promise depends on useful action without unrestricted power.
functional_properties.current_state: local policy paths exist; live mutations are zero
functional_properties.target_state: evidence-scaled autonomy per reversible action and occupation
functional_properties.residual_risk: future permits or classifications may be overbroad

functional_properties.name: governance
functional_properties.ontological_definition: Assignment and enforcement of ownership, authority, approval, verification, escalation, and revocation.
functional_properties.why_it_matters: No technical capability can legitimately decide its own authority.
functional_properties.current_state: authority separation and connector default deny are machine-enforced locally
functional_properties.target_state: complete policy-as-code with independent external authority evidence
functional_properties.residual_risk: external actors and permissions remain unresolved

meta_methodology_review.ontology_granularity: Appropriate for repository, governance, connector, occupation, and evidence boundaries; each future connector and occupation pack requires a versioned subordinate ontology.
meta_methodology_review.methodology_value: The selected stack produces concrete schemas, threat boundaries, evaluation gates, usability requirements, and deployment evidence rather than ceremonial labels.
meta_methodology_review.maturity_change: The reconstruction has advanced from locally testable code to a machine-validated project constitution, but remains pre-integration and pre-production.
meta_methodology_review.process_drag: Avoid adding methods that do not create a required artifact, reduce a named uncertainty, or control a validated risk.
meta_methodology_review.heuristics_as_facts: All heuristics remain explicitly bounded and none substitutes for current provider authority or occupational evidence.
meta_methodology_review.metrics_measure_value: Guardrails pair coverage and throughput measures with verified task success, correction, authority, blast radius, and cost.
gameable_metrics: connector certification coverage without narrow scope
meta_methodology_review.uncertainty_actionability: Repository-local uncertainty is low enough for MCP facade and occupation-schema work; live connector uncertainty remains too high for execution.
meta_methodology_review.experiment_opportunity: Use small zero-egress connector and occupation experiments before requesting live mutation authority.
meta_methodology_review.formal_verification_need: Reserve formal verification for permit, authority, state-transition, and evidence invariants.
meta_methodology_review.governance_change_needed: Yes: production requires separate connector, permit, verifier, and employer/evaluator authorities with revocation and emergency-stop paths.
meta_methodology_review.next_review_trigger: Reassess after one Deep Research evidence packet and one selected occupation pack complete independent zero-egress evaluation with employer-reviewed acceptance criteria.
